summary: Reproduced the opaque lld failure in the real gpu-module-to-binary path, then added deterministic validated ROCm toolkit discovery for explicit roots, standard ROCm variables, process PATH, and /opt/rocm.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before regression in the actual gpu-module-to-binary path; diagnostic was the opaque 'lld invocation failed'.
Explicit-root precedence, fatbin compilation, gfx950 execution, and numerical max error 0.00e+00 against Torch a+b.

tests.what_was_measured: Process-local PATH discovery, fatbin compilation, gfx950 execution, and numerical max error 0.00e+00.
Alternate standard ROCm root compilation and numerical max error 0.00e+00.
Clear missing-linker diagnostic naming the explicit variable and exact path.
Clear non-executable-linker diagnostic naming the explicit variable and exact path.
Real compiler evidence: fatbin MLIR, LLVM IR, and gfx950 ISA containing the kernel, target directive, s_endpgm, and AMDHSA metadata; GPU max error 0.00e+00.
Full unit regression suite: 1102 passed, 17 skipped.

gpu_execution_evidence: The FlyDSL vector-add kernel compiled through gpu-module-to-binary and executed on one AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950 for explicit-root, ROCM_PATH, PATH-discovered, and ISA-dump runs; each reported max error 0.00e+00 against Torch a+b.
remaining_limitations: gfx1250 and ROCm 6 were unavailable and remain unverified. Hardware execution and ISA evidence are for gfx950 on ROCm 7.2. No C++ code changed, so the prepared pinned native library was used without rebuilding.
